name: ikat-sandbox
description: Ikat's free web app: your accounts, net worth, transactions, spending, budgets and bills, on your own machine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
